## The **technology** and **innovation** to simplify a complex world

Our differentiated solutions solve challenges all over the globe.

[READ MORE][28]

## Reliable, resilient
## **power** management
## for **data centers**

Data centers power the digital services we rely on every day. Learn how AMETEK solutions address the
**complex energy management** challenges that data center operators face.

[READ MORE][29]

## The** career opportunities** to let bold talent flourish

Our inclusive culture empowers our employees to perform at their best.

[READ MORE][30]

## De-risking **data centers**

**Real-time simulation** is reshaping how data centers manage risk across their power systems. Learn
how AMETEK is helping **data centers de‑risk power systems** and accelerate deployment.

[READ MORE][31]

### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

### Learn more about **AMETEK**

#### Sustainability

## Metallography Equipment & Consumables for Materials Preparation

Buehler provides industry-leading metallography equipment, metallographic testing equipment, and
consumables for every stage of the material preparation process. From sectioning and mounting to
grinding, polishing, etching, image analysis, and hardness testing. Our solutions help laboratories
produce accurate, repeatable results for materials analysis and quality control.

### Sectioning & Cutting

[Sectioning Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Sectioning]

Buehler sectioning and cutting equipment delivers precise, repeatable sample preparation for metals,
composites, ceramics, and advanced materials. Our abrasive cutters, precision cutters, and
metallographic cutting blades help laboratories achieve high-quality cuts while improving efficiency
and consistency.

[ View Sectioning Equipment ][52]

### Mounting

[Mounting Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Mounting]

Buehler mounting solutions support reliable specimen preparation for metallographic analysis and
materials testing. Choose from cold mounting systems, including epoxies and acrylics, or hot
compression mounting equipment and powders designed for a wide range of laboratory applications.

[ View Mounting Solutions ][53]

## Metallography Equipment & Consumables for Materials Preparation

Buehler provides industry-leading metallography equipment, metallographic testing equipment, and
consumables for every stage of the material preparation process. From sectioning and mounting to
grinding, polishing, etching, image analysis, and hardness testing. Our solutions help laboratories
produce accurate, repeatable results for materials analysis and quality control.

### Sectioning & Cutting

[Sectioning Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Sectioning]

Buehler sectioning and cutting equipment delivers precise, repeatable sample preparation for metals,
composites, ceramics, and advanced materials. Our abrasive cutters, precision cutters, and
metallographic cutting blades help laboratories achieve high-quality cuts while improving efficiency
and consistency.

[ View Sectioning Equipment ][52]

### Mounting

[Mounting Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Mounting]

Buehler mounting solutions support reliable specimen preparation for metallographic analysis and
materials testing. Choose from cold mounting systems, including epoxies and acrylics, or hot
compression mounting equipment and powders designed for a wide range of laboratory applications.

[ View Mounting Solutions ][53]

### Grinding & Polishing

[Grinding & Polishing Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Grinding & Polishing]

Buehler grinding and polishing equipment helps laboratories improve surface finish quality, reduce
preparation time, and produce consistent results. Our portfolio includes grinder-polishers,
vibratory polishers, grinding papers, polishing cloths, and metallurgical polishing consumables.

[ View Grinding & Polishing Equipment ][54]

### Etching

[Buehler Products Etching]
[Buehler Etching Products]

Buehler electrolytic etching systems provide a safe, repeatable method for revealing microstructures
following metallographic grinding and polishing. Designed for accurate materials analysis, our
etching solutions help laboratories achieve consistent and reliable results.

[ View Etching Solutions ][55]

### Metallographic Image Analysis & Hardness Testing Equipment

#### Image & Analysis

[Image & Analysis Hexagon]
[Metallographic analysis using image & analysis]
OmniMet^{®} Image Analysis Systems simplify metallographic evaluation through powerful imaging,
measurement, and reporting capabilities. Designed for laboratories requiring accurate
microstructural analysis, OmniMet combines advanced analytical tools with an intuitive user
experience.
[ View Image Analysis Products ][56]

#### Hardness Testing

[Hardness Testing Hexagon]
[Metallographic analysis using hardness testers]
Buehler hardness testing equipment delivers accurate, repeatable results through intuitive software,
automated workflows, and industry-leading testing technology. Our Wilson^{®} product line includes
Rockwell^{®}, Vickers, Knoop, and Brinell hardness testers for a wide range of materials testing
applications.
[ View Hardness Testing Products ][57]
[Solutions by Industry]

### Metallography Solutions by Industry

#### Material Preparation, Testing & Analysis Solutions to Meet Industry Needs

Buehler supports laboratories across aerospace, automotive, medical device, electronics, energy,
steel, research, and advanced manufacturing industries with complete metallography, hardness
testing, and materials analysis solutions. Our equipment, consumables, and application expertise
help organizations achieve accurate and repeatable results.

##### About Buehler

Buehler is a global leader in metallography equipment and sample preparation solutions. Our
metallography instruments include sectioning machines, mounting systems, grinders, polishers, image
and analysis, etching  and hardness testers — all designed for precision and repeatability. With
decades of experience in metallographic analysis, Buehler provides expert guidance on selecting the
right preparation method for your lab’s needs. Our metallography solutions support a wide range of
applications, including quality control, research and development, production testing, and failure
analysis across both metallic and nonmetallic materials.

## Metallography Equipment & Consumables for Materials Preparation

Buehler provides industry-leading metallography equipment, metallographic testing equipment, and
consumables for every stage of the material preparation process. From sectioning and mounting to
grinding, polishing, etching, image analysis, and hardness testing. Our solutions help laboratories
produce accurate, repeatable results for materials analysis and quality control.

### Sectioning & Cutting

[Sectioning Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Sectioning]

Buehler sectioning and cutting equipment delivers precise, repeatable sample preparation for metals,
composites, ceramics, and advanced materials. Our abrasive cutters, precision cutters, and
metallographic cutting blades help laboratories achieve high-quality cuts while improving efficiency
and consistency.

[ View Sectioning Equipment ][52]

### Mounting

[Mounting Products Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Mounting]

Buehler mounting solutions support reliable specimen preparation for metallographic analysis and
materials testing. Choose from cold mounting systems, including epoxies and acrylics, or hot
compression mounting equipment and powders designed for a wide range of laboratory applications.

[ View Mounting Solutions ][53]

### Grinding & Polishing

[Grinding & Polishing Hexagon]
[Metallography products for Grinding & Polishing]

Buehler grinding and polishing equipment helps laboratories improve surface finish quality, reduce
preparation time, and produce consistent results. Our portfolio includes grinder-polishers,
vibratory polishers, grinding papers, polishing cloths, and metallurgical polishing consumables.

[ View Grinding & Polishing Equipment ][54]

### Etching

[Buehler Products Etching]
[Buehler Etching Products]

Buehler electrolytic etching systems provide a safe, repeatable method for revealing microstructures
following metallographic grinding and polishing. Designed for accurate materials analysis, our
etching solutions help laboratories achieve consistent and reliable results.

[ View Etching Solutions ][55]

### Metallographic Image Analysis & Hardness Testing Equipment

#### Image & Analysis

[Image & Analysis Hexagon]
[Metallographic analysis using image & analysis]
OmniMet^{®} Image Analysis Systems simplify metallographic evaluation through powerful imaging,
measurement, and reporting capabilities. Designed for laboratories requiring accurate
microstructural analysis, OmniMet combines advanced analytical tools with an intuitive user
experience.
[ View Image Analysis Products ][56]

#### Hardness Testing

[Hardness Testing Hexagon]
[Metallographic analysis using hardness testers]
Buehler hardness testing equipment delivers accurate, repeatable results through intuitive software,
automated workflows, and industry-leading testing technology. Our Wilson^{®} product line includes
Rockwell^{®}, Vickers, Knoop, and Brinell hardness testers for a wide range of materials testing
applications.
[ View Hardness Testing Products ][57]
[Solutions by Industry]

### Metallography Solutions by Industry

#### Material Preparation, Testing & Analysis Solutions to Meet Industry Needs

Buehler supports laboratories across aerospace, automotive, medical device, electronics, energy,
steel, research, and advanced manufacturing industries with complete metallography, hardness
testing, and materials analysis solutions. Our equipment, consumables, and application expertise
help organizations achieve accurate and repeatable results.

Buehler is a global leader in metallography equipment and sample preparation solutions. Our
metallography instruments include sectioning machines, mounting systems, grinders, polishers, image

As a global leader in dynamic **measurement technology** for measuring pressure, force, torque and
acceleration, we support our customers in industry and science to improve their products and make
their manufacturing processes more efficient. The piezoelectric **sensor **is at the heart of every
**measurement system** from Kistler and, based on piezoelectric technology, the most important
element of our **measurement technology.**

To offer you **sensors, measurement systems** and services that are exactly tailored to your needs,
we fully focus upon the complex current and future challenges in the areas of automobile
development, industrial automation and in fields related to extreme environments. We are a dedicated
industry insider and by offering our **measurement technology,** make important contributions
towards the further development of current megatrends, including electrified drive technology,
autonomous driving, emission reduction and Industry 4.0. Built upon more than 60 years of deep
application knowledge, our comprehensive product portfolio covers all applications and services in
piezoelectric** measurement technology.**

# Piezoelectric measurement technology from Kistler - complete systems from sensor to cloud


As a global leader in dynamic **measurement technology** for measuring pressure, force, torque and
acceleration, we support our customers in industry and science to improve their products and make
their manufacturing processes more efficient. The piezoelectric **sensor **is at the heart of every
**measurement system** from Kistler and, based on piezoelectric technology, the most important
element of our **measurement technology.**

To offer you **sensors, measurement systems** and services that are exactly tailored to your needs,
we fully focus upon the complex current and future challenges in the areas of automobile
development, industrial automation and in fields related to extreme environments. We are a dedicated
industry insider and by offering our **measurement technology,** make important contributions
towards the further development of current megatrends, including electrified drive technology,
autonomous driving, emission reduction and Industry 4.0. Built upon more than 60 years of deep
application knowledge, our comprehensive product portfolio covers all applications and services in
piezoelectric** measurement technology.**

### Why choose Tinius Olsen?

Tinius Olsen himself invented the first universal testing machine in 1880 and, throughout its
history, the company has been at the forefront of development and innovation. Whether you are
looking for a single testing machine or a fully automated system that runs 24 hours a day, 365 days
a year, you can be sure that every element has been designed and tested to the highest Tinius Olsen
standards.

### Productivity, Repeatability, Traceability

Tinius Olsen offers solutions for testing the strength and performance of plastics, metals,
composites and many other materials through tensile, flexural, compression, folding endurance,
impact, heat distortion, Vicat, melt flow, tear and puncture tests. Our versatile testing machines
can perform tests in accordance with ASTM, ISO and other international standards from test
configuration through to reporting and generating results immediately for your processes.

[[arrow-icon] More][50]
[productivity-img]

## Featured Products

### Automated Systems

[horizon]

Tinius Olsen has developed scalable technology blocks to automate tensile, compression, flexural,
impact, melt flow and hardness tests. Capable of testing up to 1000+ specimens in a 24-hour period,
saving time and making money.

[ [arrow-icon] More][51]

### VectorExtensometer

[epsilon]

**The Future of Extensometry**
Tinius Olsen introduces Vector a step change in extensometer technology capable of replacing
multiple contacting and non-contacting sensors with a single, industry specific instrument.
Integrating adaptive AI capabilities with optical hardware, Vector reduces test throughput times and
complexity, automating the process of capturing strain, improving measurement accuracy, data
consistency and operator safety.

[ [arrow-icon] More][52]

### Horizon Software

[featured-img]

Horizon makes all your testing as effortless as it should be. It helps you meet your R&D and quality
control needs, working simply, efficiently and accurately to carry out your testing, presenting
visible data in real time. You can use it on multiple machines and PCs so that programs and data can
be shared across your network, while maintaining security and data integrity throughout.

[ [arrow-icon] More][53]

### Why choose Tinius Olsen?

Tinius Olsen himself invented the first universal testing machine in 1880 and, throughout its
history, the company has been at the forefront of development and innovation. Whether you are
looking for a single testing machine or a fully automated system that runs 24 hours a day, 365 days
a year, you can be sure that every element has been designed and tested to the highest Tinius Olsen
standards.

### Productivity, Repeatability, Traceability

Tinius Olsen offers solutions for testing the strength and performance of plastics, metals,
composites and many other materials through tensile, flexural, compression, folding endurance,
impact, heat distortion, Vicat, melt flow, tear and puncture tests. Our versatile testing machines
can perform tests in accordance with ASTM, ISO and other international standards from test
configuration through to reporting and generating results immediately for your processes.

[[arrow-icon] More][50]
[productivity-img]

## Featured Products

### Automated Systems

[horizon]

Tinius Olsen has developed scalable technology blocks to automate tensile, compression, flexural,
impact, melt flow and hardness tests. Capable of testing up to 1000+ specimens in a 24-hour period,
saving time and making money.

[ [arrow-icon] More][51]

### VectorExtensometer

[epsilon]

**The Future of Extensometry**
Tinius Olsen introduces Vector a step change in extensometer technology capable of replacing
multiple contacting and non-contacting sensors with a single, industry specific instrument.
Integrating adaptive AI capabilities with optical hardware, Vector reduces test throughput times and
complexity, automating the process of capturing strain, improving measurement accuracy, data
consistency and operator safety.

[ [arrow-icon] More][52]

### Horizon Software

[featured-img]

Horizon makes all your testing as effortless as it should be. It helps you meet your R&D and quality
control needs, working simply, efficiently and accurately to carry out your testing, presenting
visible data in real time. You can use it on multiple machines and PCs so that programs and data can
be shared across your network, while maintaining security and data integrity throughout.

customer focus, giving a very positive and dynamic cooperation. They possess extensive knowledge of
wind turbine blades and quality assurance, a very strong combination making them a trusted supplier

Head of Technical Integrity Management, Ørsted

[Ørsted logo – customer of AeroNordic]

system, for our asset management organisation. The system spans from quality assurance business
processes to the operational maintenance instructions. The quality of the deliverables is high-end,
tailored to our requirements, the price is fixed and they always deliver on time or ahead of
schedule.”

**– Morten Egholm Handberg**
Senior Blade Integrity Specialist, Ørsted

[Ørsted logo – customer of AeroNordic]

# AeroNordic – Independent Test Laboratory for Composite Materials

AeroNordic is an independent, Danish test laboratory and engineering company specialising in
composite materials and wind turbine blades. We offer specimen manufacturing, material testing, and
engineering support – all under one roof and in full compliance with international ISO and ASTM
standards.

We work with customers in more than 24 countries and have performed over 1,600 material tests and
manufactured more than 3,500 test specimens. Our customers include leading companies in the wind
energy and composite materials industry, including Ørsted.

Our most in-demand services:
– Rain Erosion Testing (DNVGL-RP-0171)
– Accelerated Artificial Weathering (ISO 12944)
– Fatigue Testing (ISO 13001 / ASTM D3479)
– Specimen Manufacturing for Leading Edge Protection (LEP)
– DNVGL-RP-0573 LEP Screening & Full Qualification

We are located near motorway E45 in Horsens, Denmark.

# AeroNordic – Independent Test Laboratory for Composite Materials

AeroNordic is an independent, Danish test laboratory and engineering company specialising in
composite materials and wind turbine blades. We offer specimen manufacturing, material testing, and
engineering support – all under one roof and in full compliance with international ISO and ASTM
standards.

We work with customers in more than 24 countries and have performed over 1,600 material tests and
manufactured more than 3,500 test specimens. Our customers include leading companies in the wind
energy and composite materials industry, including Ørsted.

Our most in-demand services:
– Rain Erosion Testing (DNVGL-RP-0171)
– Accelerated Artificial Weathering (ISO 12944)
– Fatigue Testing (ISO 13001 / ASTM D3479)
– Specimen Manufacturing for Leading Edge Protection (LEP)
– DNVGL-RP-0573 LEP Screening & Full Qualification

We are located near motorway E45 in Horsens, Denmark.

## 01 System Solutions

We can integrate our equipment into system solutions such as weighing and batching, ingredient
handling and semi-automated bulk bag filling to increase operational efficiency, reduce workload,
improve safety and meet your product objectives. Our team works closely with you to maximize the
efficiency of your operations.

Akona’s weighing and batching systems are built to deliver precise measurement and controlled
material flow for materials being handled. They automate the batching process to improve
consistency, reduce cycle times and eliminate manual errors. Engineered for reliability and

increase overall productivity.

Our ingredient handling systems are designed to deliver the exact ingredients needed, safely and
efficiently. From storage to transfer, they ensure precise, hygienic delivery and seamless
integration with your process.

Akona’s semi-automated bulk bag filling solutions combine precision and ease of use to deliver
consistent, high-efficiency packaging. Designed to reduce manual handling, these systems help scale
your operations while improving throughput and accuracy.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

# We Make Fencing Possible


Excitement, passion and pulsating energy, felt in every movement, in every hit, in every cry of
victory. Fencing is precision, endurance, discipline and pure emotion. As the No. 1 in fencing, we
don't just understand the world of fencing - we live it. We turn dreams into aspirations by
equipping fencers of every generation with everything they need - high-quality and innovative
fencing equipment, from weapons to fencing socks. We offer our fencing community in over 160
countries allstar products renowned for highest quality and best performance. In short: We make
fencing possible. 

 As a family-run global player in its 4th generation, we have been living the passion for this
unique sport for six decades. We are pioneers, constantly evolving and driven by an unwavering
spirit of innovation. The needs and safety of our athletes are always our top priority. They
motivate us to give our best every day.

# AMBRELL INDUCTION HEATING SOLUTIONS

## Do you use heat in your process?

Our remarkable induction heating systems provide a precise, repeatable, non-contact heating process
for your electrically-conductive materials in a flameless, cleaner, and more comfortable work
environment. Our expert lab and dedicated service teams ensure you have the process and production
you need.

coil.

**About Us**

**Apan Enterprise **initiated its operations to draw benefits from the emerging needs of branded,
high performing and reliable products on the global platform. 

Throughout our years of foundation, we have worked hard to become an approved and authorized dealer
for marketing and sailing technology based global brands like **Aimil Ltd., Elcometer Ltd., MBH
Analytical Ltd., Endecotts Ltd., Glen Creston Ltd.** With our efforts and pragmatic business
approach, we have been able to meet and exceed our clients expectations. 

Our main objective is to achieve customer satisfaction and we always seek to achieve it by making
sure that our products are thoroughly tested and evaluated during the research and development phase
and very rigorously tested before shipping to any of our customers.

Core team of Apan Enterprise have 19 years business development experience & dedicated to providing
the best product in value, performance and reliability.

**Our Product Portfolio**

* **Analytical Instrument**

* **Test Sieve**

* **Chemical Standard Certified Reference Materials**
* **MBH Analytical**

# ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ - Εξοπλισμός Εργαστηρίων

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. δραστηριοποιείται:

Στον τομέα του Εξοπλισμού Εργαστηρίων Έρευνας και Ανάπτυξης, Ποιοτικού Ελέγχου, Βιοϊατρικής και
Βιοτεχνολογίας, με πλήρεις λύσεις συμπεριλαμβανομένης της μελέτης και οργάνωσης των εργαστηρίων.

Στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής και Ηλεκτροτεχνικής Βιομηχανίας, με εξοπλισμό για την ανάπτυξη της
παραγωγικής διαδικασίας και πλήρη κάλυψη σε πρώτες ύλες και υλικά.

## Παρέχουμε προϊόντα και υπηρεσίες υψηλής ποιότητας

που προσαρμόζονται στις ανάγκες των πελατών μας

Εγκαταστάσεις Εκπαιδεύσεις Εφαρμογές Δοκιμές & Διακριβώσεις Service

Ο πελάτης λαμβάνει συμβουλές για τις απαιτήσεις χώρου και περιβάλλοντος, ενώ επίσης εξετάζονται οι
προδιαγραφές για την ηλεκτρική παροχή και τις απαιτήσεις αερίων ή νερού πριν από την εγκατάσταση.

Οποιαδήποτε εγκατάσταση και λειτουργία συσκευής γίνεται σύμφωνα με τις οδηγίες του κατασκευαστή και
μπορεί να απαιτηθεί πλήρως τεκμηριωμένος έλεγχος IQ/OQ αν το επιθυμεί ο πελάτης.

[shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview][shutterstock_100411144__1_-removebg-preview]

Οι χρήστες του οργάνου εκπαιδεύονται πλήρως από εξειδικευμένο προσωπικό.

**Κάθε εκπαίδευση συνοδεύεται από ένα πιστοποιητικό εκπαίδευσης** στο όνομα του χρήστη,
υπογεγραμμένο από τον εκπαιδευτή.

[shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview][shutterstock_245572090-removebg-preview]

Πέρα από τη βασική εκπαίδευση για τη χρήση του εξοπλισμού, ο πελάτης μπορεί να επιλέξει να λάβει μια
πλήρως δοκιμασμένη εφαρμογή που αναπτύσσεται από το Τμήμα Εφαρμογών μας.

Αυτή η υπηρεσία στοχεύει στην προσαρμογή στις ανάγκες του πελάτη και στη δημιουργία λειτουργικής
ημερήσιας διαδικασίας, περιλαμβάνοντας βελτιστοποίηση της προετοιμασίας δειγμάτων, ανάπτυξη μεθόδου
επεξεργασίας δειγμάτων, συλλογή δεδομένων, και επαλήθευση αποτελεσμάτων με εργαστήρια τρίτων.

[shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview][shutterstock_1538502419-removebg-preview]

Για να εξασφαλίσει την ποιότητα των αποτελεσμάτων, ο πελάτης πρέπει να επιβεβαιώνει περιοδικά ότι το
όργανό του λειτουργεί σύμφωνα με τις προδιαγραφές του κατασκευαστή.

Η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. διασφαλίζει αυτήν τη διαδικασία μέσω συνεχούς εκπαίδευσης των τεχνικών της στις
εγκαταστάσεις των κατασκευαστών για ελέγχους IQ/OQ/PQ για κάθε προμηθευθέν όργανο.

Επιπλέον, η εταιρεία επενδύει σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό δοκιμών, ο οποίος διατηρείται και διακριβώνεται
σε τακτικά διαστήματα από ανεξάρτητα εργαστήρια.

[shutterstock_2278230623-removebg-preview][shutterstock_2278230623-removebg-preview]

Στη Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. η δέσμευσή μας για παροχή υψηλής ποιότητας επιστημονικού και αναλυτικού
εξοπλισμού συνοδεύεται από απαράμιλλη υποστήριξη μέσω του Τμήματος Τεχνικής Υποστήριξης Αθηνών, το
οποίο αποτελεί θεμέλιο της ικανοποίησης των πελατών μας.

Η ομάδα μας αποτελείτε από έμπειρους και πιστοποιημένους τεχνικούς με βαθιά γνώση των επιστημονικών
και αναλυτικών οργάνων που διανέμουμε. Μπορείτε να μας εμπιστευτείτε για την κατανόηση των
λεπτομερειών του εξοπλισμού σας, εξασφαλίζοντας ακριβείς διαγνώσεις και αποτελεσματικές λύσεις.

## Σχετικά με Εμάς

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων. 

Το 1985, η εταιρεία αποκτά τη σημερινή της νομική μορφή, με πυξίδα την ποιότητα, την αξιοπιστία και
την τεχνολογική υπεροχή. Πίσω από τη σταθερή και διαρκώς εξελισσόμενη πορεία της βρίσκεται η δύναμη
της οικογένειας: τον ιδρυτή Νικόλαο Αστεριάδη διαδέχθηκαν οι γιοι του, Γιώργος και Θανάσης, ενώ από
το 2021 ξεκίνησε η μετάβαση στη νέα εποχή με την ενεργή συμμετοχή της τρίτης γενιάς και του εγγονού
του ιδρυτή, Νίκου Αστεριάδη. 

Σήμερα, η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. αντιπροσωπεύει κορυφαίους διεθνείς κατασκευαστές, όπως οι Shimadzu,
JEOL, Renishaw, Sercon και πολλοί άλλοι. Παρέχει ολοκληρωμένες λύσεις υψηλής ποιότητας σε αναλυτικά
όργανα, ηλεκτρονικά μικροσκόπια, εργαστηριακό εξοπλισμό και αναλώσιμα. 

Με επτά δεκαετίες αδιάλειπτης παρουσίας, η εταιρεία συνεχίζει να αποτελεί υπόδειγμα ελληνικής
οικογενειακής επιχείρησης που συνδυάζει παράδοση, τεχνογνωσία και ματιά στραμμένη στο μέλλον.

## Σχετικά με Εμάς

Η ιστορία της Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. ξεκινά το 1955, όταν ο Νικόλαος Αστεριάδης ιδρύει την τότε
«ΝΙΚΟΛΑΟΣ ΑΣΤΕΡΙΑΔΗΣ» στη Θεσσαλονίκη – μια μικρή επιχείρηση με μεγάλο όραμα: να φέρει στην Ελλάδα
την τεχνολογική πρόοδο μέσα από την επιστημονική και βιομηχανική καινοτομία. Ένα όραμα που
εξελίχθηκε, επεκτάθηκε και σταθεροποιήθηκε το 1985 με τη σύσταση της σημερινής εταιρικής μορφής. 

Αρχικά δραστηριοποιούμενη ως αντιπρόσωπος εταιρειών επιστημονικών οργάνων της Αθήνας στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα, η εταιρεία δεν άργησε να χαράξει τη δική της αυτόνομη πορεία. Σημαντικοί σταθμοί ήταν η
συνεργασία με την Eppendorf, καθώς και η αποκλειστική διάθεση των μικροσκοπίων ZEISS στη Βόρεια
Ελλάδα. Από τα μέσα της δεκαετίας του ’60, διευρύνει τις δραστηριότητές της στον τομέα του
επαγγελματικού ήχου και της εμπορίας ηλεκτρονικών εξαρτημάτων, ενώ το 1967 αποκτά παρουσία και στην
Αθήνα με νέο υποκατάστημα. 

Το 1973, η συνεργασία με τη JEOL καθιστά την εταιρεία πρωτοπόρο στον τομέα της Ηλεκτρονικής
Μικροσκοπίας, ενώ η στρατηγική συμμαχία με τη SHIMADZU το 1978 δίνει νέα ώθηση στην αγορά των
Αναλυτικών Οργάνων. 

Το 1985, η εταιρεία αποκτά τη σημερινή της νομική μορφή, με πυξίδα την ποιότητα, την αξιοπιστία και
την τεχνολογική υπεροχή. Πίσω από τη σταθερή και διαρκώς εξελισσόμενη πορεία της βρίσκεται η δύναμη
της οικογένειας: τον ιδρυτή Νικόλαο Αστεριάδη διαδέχθηκαν οι γιοι του, Γιώργος και Θανάσης, ενώ από
το 2021 ξεκίνησε η μετάβαση στη νέα εποχή με την ενεργή συμμετοχή της τρίτης γενιάς και του εγγονού
του ιδρυτή, Νίκου Αστεριάδη. 

Σήμερα, η Ν. Αστεριάδης Α.Ε. αντιπροσωπεύει κορυφαίους διεθνείς κατασκευαστές, όπως οι Shimadzu,
JEOL, Renishaw, Sercon και πολλοί άλλοι. Παρέχει ολοκληρωμένες λύσεις υψηλής ποιότητας σε αναλυτικά
όργανα, ηλεκτρονικά μικροσκόπια, εργαστηριακό εξοπλισμό και αναλώσιμα. 

Με επτά δεκαετίες αδιάλειπτης παρουσίας, η εταιρεία συνεχίζει να αποτελεί υπόδειγμα ελληνικής
οικογενειακής επιχείρησης που συνδυάζει παράδοση, τεχνογνωσία και ματιά στραμμένη στο μέλλον.

### ATLAS AT A GLANCE

For more than 100 years, Atlas has been a leader in materials durability testing, offering a
complete line of weathering testing instrumentation, laboratory, and outdoor testing services. Atlas
products are designed and manufactured to conform to international and industry standard test
methods, including ISO, ASTM, DIN, JIS and numerous others. Markets include automotive, paint and
coatings, plastics and additives, textiles, pharmaceutical and consumer products, architecture,
aerospace, photovoltaics, and packaging.

For more than 100 years, Atlas has been a leader in materials durability testing, offering a
complete line of weathering testing instrumentation, laboratory, and outdoor testing services. Atlas

methods, including ISO, ASTM, DIN, JIS and numerous others. Markets include automotive, paint and
coatings, plastics and additives, textiles, pharmaceutical and consumer products, architecture,
aerospace, photovoltaics, and packaging.

### Search

Enter a company name or SEC Registration Number to view details of any business registered in the
Philippines

### View Data

Instantly access company profiles for business verification. Purchase extended reports to see
ownership, capital, directorship and financial information

Reports are compiled and sent directly to your email, typically within one business day (depends on

Our Philippine Company Search combines registry data with verified updates

Whether for KYC, AMLA checks, onboarding, investments, or legal reviews, our platform makes it
seamless. Search by company name or SEC Registration Number — our reports are based on latest

## Features & Benefits
1. Official Registry Data

2. Directors & Shareholders

   Gain insights on a company's financial performance
4. Compliance Ready
   
   Reports are structured for KYC, KYB, AMLA compliance and due diligence
5. Digital Access
   
   Download reports in PDF or share online securely

## Why Clients Trust Us?

[ Learn more about us ][21]

Official Source

Data sourced directly from authoritative registries

Secure & Private

HTTPS encryption on all platforms and secure Stripe payment processing

Proven Expertise

Trusted by law firms, banks, and multinational compliance teams

## Frequently Asked Questions

How do I pay for the Philippines company reports?
You can buy reports with a credit card:
1. [Search][22] for a company and add reports to your cart.
2. Go to [Checkout][23] and pay by card.
3. Your reports will be emailed after payment.
How fast do I get a Philippines company report?
Most reports are delivered within one business day. You will see the expected timeline on the
checkout page.
What if I can’t find a Philippine company?
Click "I can't find a company" under the search bar and our support team can check manually with SEC
records.
Why haven't I received the report I purchased?
It could be due to:
1. **Processing time** – Some reports take longer; delivery time is shown at checkout.
2. **Spam folder** – Check your spam/junk mail.
3. **Public holiday** – We may be waiting on updated data.

Still unsure? [Contact us here][24] and we'll help you quickly.

I made a duplicate order.
Ordered the same report more than once? Let us know and we’ll refund the duplicate or offer another
report.
Can I use your reports for cross-border due diligence?
Yes, our reports come from authoritative sources and are widely accepted for KYC, compliance, and
international due diligence.
How do I remove my company from Companies House?
We don’t manually add or remove companies — we use government datasets. You can add more info to
your page or let us know if your company is dissolved or renamed.

## Premium & Custom Solutions

### Premium Order

Priority Delivery
Your requests are processed with top priority, ensuring reports on Philippine companies are prepared
and delivered with the fastest possible turnaround.
Effortless Ordering
Skip the card payments — our streamlined online ordering lets you request reports instantly, saving
time and keeping your focus on critical compliance tasks.
Exclusive Pricing
Benefit from discounted rates on bulk orders. We help you keep compliance costs under control while
guaranteeing reliable and accurate SEC data.
[ Contact ][25]

### Custom Order

Comprehensive Data
We aggregate information from SEC filings, DTI registrations, BIR records, and other trusted sources
to give you a complete, verified company profile.
Detailed Insights
Beyond registry data, we can include litigation checks, AMLA compliance screening, media reviews,
and stakeholder references to strengthen your due diligence process.

### Our Commitment: Precision, Reliability & Innovation

At the heart of Derui lies a commitment to engineering **material testing equipment** you can trust.
We believe in empowering your **quality control and R&D** with solutions that are not only precise
and reliable but also intelligently designed for the future.

**Driven by Precision:** Every **universal testing machine** and piece of **lab equipment** we build
is engineered for accuracy that meets and exceeds ASTM, ISO, and global standards.

**Built on Reliability:** We design for durability, ensuring our **testing equipment** delivers
consistent performance in your demanding industrial or research environment.

**Focused on Sustainable Innovation:** As a forward-looking **manufacturer**, we integrate
efficient, low-carbon principles into our technology, helping you advance both your products and
your sustainability goals.

[Derui Company Culture Wall Display]

### Our Capabilities: Your Complete Testing Equipment Solution

**In-House R&D & Custom Engineering:** We transform standards and your requirements into precise,
purpose-built **testing solutions**.

**Precision Manufacturing:** Advanced facilities and rigorous quality control build **universal
testing machines** for exceptional accuracy and durability.

**Comprehensive Portfolio:** From standard **UTMs** to specialized **lab equipment**, we cover all
your **material testing** needs.

**Expert Support:** From consultation to installation and ongoing support, we maximize your
operational uptime.

**End-to-End Quality:** Our commitment spans from design to after-sales care,
guaranteeing **reliable test equipment**.

[Derui Company School and Training Area]

### Two Decades of Expertise: A Team Dedicated to Your Success

For over 20 years, Derui’s mission has been to engineer the most reliable **material testing
equipment**. Our strength is our team—a diverse group of engineers and specialists united by deep
expertise and a collaborative spirit.

This **collective experience** means we deeply understand the complex **testing
challenges** in **aerospace, automotive, and manufacturing**. We know not only how to build
a **universal testing machine**, but how to optimize it for your specific materials and standards.

**We turn our experience into your advantage:**

**Proven & Reliable Solutions:** We leverage decades of project insights to deliver
efficient, **reliable testing equipment** that avoids common pitfalls.

**Seamless Partnership & Support:** From initial design to installation and beyond, our team works
as an extension of yours, ensuring your **testing solutions** perform as expected.

Partner with Derui for confidence built on twenty years of expertise.

For many dental students, digital dentistry is still limited to a few classroom exercises. For Dr.
János Panyi, his curiosity pushed him to dive into digital long before graduation. In this exoBlog,
we hear how discovering exocad software through the student license helped János hone the skills he
now uses every day in practice.

[Read the interview][77]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

## How to purchase exocad software

support, offers or more information, please contact one of our partners.

approached by Boynton for their Platinum Mine in the Pilanesberg to find a solution to the lack of
sufficient feed into the plant from their existing Tip Areas, which had been ongoing for a few
years. Three tip areas […]

## WHY DO YOU LIKE GK?

*Where can you go buy a used piece of equipment? Not touch it, set it up, and have it run for three
years? We've replaced two belts, two springs, and a rocker arm - that's it. It's built to last.*

Ron Tazelaar, TAZ Recycling

*Two of our plants have GK screens running 20 hrs/day, 6 days/week. GK’s robust design has
translated into minimal downtime. Our maintenance guys love it. The screens have performed
fantastically and are a critical part of our manufacturing process.*

Rashid Shakir, Dir. of Engineering American Wood Fibers

*I would like to express my appreciation to all of those who put forth their best efforts to make
the mold dump replacement project successful. We started up the conveyor this morning on time and it
performs just as expected. There is good mold separation along the conveyor, the current readings
are good, and the unit runs quiet and level. Everything we expected to see. Thank you!*

*We appreciate all the help that General Kinematics has given us towards design our reclamation
system. All of the pieces are staring to come together we are very excited to see the final result
once we get our system up and running.*

Brad Moore, Project Manager, Badger Alloys

You can request a quote through our contact form, or call us directly. Most quotes are returned

scroll through the version timeline.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## Who We Are

Infinita Lab is a U.S.-based material testing services company built around a simple observation:
the way most companies access lab testing is broken.

If you’ve ever had to qualify a new material, validate a prototype, or run a batch of compliance
tests, you already know the pattern. You start with a list of labs. You email three or four. Two
come back with quotes that aren’t comparable. One disappears. One has the wrong accreditation.
Another can do part of the work but needs to subcontract the rest. Two weeks pass before your
samples have even shipped. By the time results come in, the timeline you committed to engineering or
procurement is already at risk.

We built Infinita Lab to remove that friction entirely.

Instead of running a single laboratory, we operate a curated network of 2,000+ accredited partner
labs across the United States. When you bring us a testing project, we don’t try to fit it into one
facility’s capabilities; we match it to the right facility, method, and turnaround across the
network. If your project needs ASTM E8 tensile testing on a custom alloy, environmental cycling for
an aerospace component, and SEM imaging on the resulting fracture surface, we coordinate it across
whichever labs can deliver the best combination of accuracy, speed, and cost. You see none of that
complexity. You see one quote, one scope, one point of contact, and one final report.

That single point of contact is the heart of how we work. Every engagement at Infinita Lab is led by
a master’s-level materials scientist – not an account manager, not a sales coordinator, and not a
project tracker. The person you speak with at scoping is the same person who reviews your test plan,
evaluates which methods truly apply to your material and use case, selects the lab, manages sample
logistics, reviews the data when it comes back, and walks you through what it means. They speak the
language your engineers speak. They’ve sat through failure analyses, debated test method selection
on edge cases, and translated lab reports into decisions a product team can actually act on.

This matters because materials testing isn’t a vending machine. Two labs with the same accreditation
can produce meaningfully different data depending on sample preparation, fixture choice, or
interpretation of an ambiguous standard. Knowing that – and knowing how to scope around it – is what
we mean by depth. It’s the difference between getting a result and getting a result you can defend
in a design review, a regulatory filing, or a supplier qualification meeting.

The third piece of how we work is confidentiality, and we treat it as structural rather than
optional. Every engagement runs under NDA. The same standards bind Partner labs. For clients in
IP-sensitive industries – semiconductors, aerospace, medical devices – we can anonymize lab
relationships entirely, so the testing facility never sees who the work is being performed for. Your
material specifications, formulations, and results stay yours.

We’ve delivered over 20,000 tests for 4,000+ clients across some of the most demanding sectors in
modern industry. Our work supports semiconductor teams characterizing failures in next-generation
chips, aerospace and defense suppliers qualifying composites and fasteners, automotive and EV
engineers validating batteries and lightweight structures, medical device manufacturers proving
biocompatibility, energy storage innovators stress-testing cells under real-world conditions, and
advanced manufacturers running everything from corrosion studies to dimensional metrology.

What ties these projects together isn’t a single test type. It’s that the teams running them needed
testing to move at the pace of their R&D – without sacrificing accuracy, defensibility, or
confidentiality.

That’s what Infinita Lab is built for. Breadth, because you shouldn’t be limited by what a single
facility can do. Depth, because raw data isn’t the same as a useful answer. And assurance, because
the work you’re trusting us with often represents

## Who We Are

Infinita Lab is a U.S.-based material testing services company built around a simple observation:
the way most companies access lab testing is broken.

If you’ve ever had to qualify a new material, validate a prototype, or run a batch of compliance
tests, you already know the pattern. You start with a list of labs. You email three or four. Two
come back with quotes that aren’t comparable. One disappears. One has the wrong accreditation.
Another can do part of the work but needs to subcontract the rest. Two weeks pass before your
samples have even shipped. By the time results come in, the timeline you committed to engineering or
procurement is already at risk.

We built Infinita Lab to remove that friction entirely.

Instead of running a single laboratory, we operate a curated network of 2,000+ accredited partner
labs across the United States. When you bring us a testing project, we don’t try to fit it into one
facility’s capabilities; we match it to the right facility, method, and turnaround across the
network. If your project needs ASTM E8 tensile testing on a custom alloy, environmental cycling for
an aerospace component, and SEM imaging on the resulting fracture surface, we coordinate it across
whichever labs can deliver the best combination of accuracy, speed, and cost. You see none of that
complexity. You see one quote, one scope, one point of contact, and one final report.

That single point of contact is the heart of how we work. Every engagement at Infinita Lab is led by
a master’s-level materials scientist – not an account manager, not a sales coordinator, and not a
project tracker. The person you speak with at scoping is the same person who reviews your test plan,
evaluates which methods truly apply to your material and use case, selects the lab, manages sample
logistics, reviews the data when it comes back, and walks you through what it means. They speak the
language your engineers speak. They’ve sat through failure analyses, debated test method selection
on edge cases, and translated lab reports into decisions a product team can actually act on.

This matters because materials testing isn’t a vending machine. Two labs with the same accreditation
can produce meaningfully different data depending on sample preparation, fixture choice, or
interpretation of an ambiguous standard. Knowing that – and knowing how to scope around it – is what
we mean by depth. It’s the difference between getting a result and getting a result you can defend
in a design review, a regulatory filing, or a supplier qualification meeting.

The third piece of how we work is confidentiality, and we treat it as structural rather than
optional. Every engagement runs under NDA. The same standards bind Partner labs. For clients in
IP-sensitive industries – semiconductors, aerospace, medical devices – we can anonymize lab
relationships entirely, so the testing facility never sees who the work is being performed for. Your
material specifications, formulations, and results stay yours.

We’ve delivered over 20,000 tests for 4,000+ clients across some of the most demanding sectors in
modern industry. Our work supports semiconductor teams characterizing failures in next-generation
chips, aerospace and defense suppliers qualifying composites and fasteners, automotive and EV
engineers validating batteries and lightweight structures, medical device manufacturers proving
biocompatibility, energy storage innovators stress-testing cells under real-world conditions, and
advanced manufacturers running everything from corrosion studies to dimensional metrology.

What ties these projects together isn’t a single test type. It’s that the teams running them needed
testing to move at the pace of their R&D – without sacrificing accuracy, defensibility, or
confidentiality.

That’s what Infinita Lab is built for. Breadth, because you shouldn’t be limited by what a single

## How we can help

[ITA - Athletes]

#### Ready to compete with confidence?

Complying with anti-doping rules is a big responsibility for athletes. You train hard and you train
to win. Your reputation matters and you want your hard work to be recognised. We are here to make
sure that your clean approach to sport is protected, that you can take part in healthy and fair
competitions, and that you and your competitors are treated with the professionalism and respect you
deserve.

As an organisation already sharing our global expertise with athletes around the world, we run a
wide range of education programs that support you to compete fairly, understand the rules and their
enforcement and give you the confidence you need to focus on your training and performances.

[ Read More ][88]

#### Why partner with us?

Bringing global expertise and experience to clean sport: the ITA is committed to delivering a
transparent service that helps organisations and events to be confident in their approach to keeping
sport clean.
Working with us demonstrates your determination to protect your athletes and contribute to
excellence in sporting endeavour. You will have access to our team of anti-doping experts, and you
will be able to demonstrate to your stakeholders, sponsors and fans that you are serious about a
level playing field.

[ Read More ][89]
[ITA - Partners]

## Our Partners

Witold Banka

President, World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)

We are pleased to see that the expertise of the International Testing Agency is strengthening the
anti-doping programs of International Federations and Major Event Organisers worldwide. By working
to ensure that each have efficient and compliant anti-doping programs, the ITA, along with
Anti-Doping Organizations worldwide, is helping to improve the quality of the global anti-doping
system.

Thomas Bach

Former President, International Olympic Committee (IOC)

The ITA’s initiation by the 2015 Olympic Summit was a major milestone in the fight against doping.
Through the ITA, anti-doping testing becomes independent from sports organisations and national
interests. This independence is vital to ensuring a level playing field for all athletes and greatly
supports the credibility of the anti-doping system.

David Lappartient

President, Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI)

In entrusting its anti-doping operations to the ITA, the UCI ensured that cycling could maintain and
strengthen its mission to protect clean athletes.

Totally independent from the UCI, our sport’s anti-doping programme benefits greatly from the ITA’s
global approach, which guarantees synergies in key areas such as research, science, intelligence and
investigations, testing, and education.

Marcos Diaz

Chairperson of the UNESCO Bureau of the seventh session of the Conference of Parties to the
International Convention against Doping in Sport

As Chairperson of representatives of global public authorities to the Conference of Parties (COP) of
the International Convention against Doping in Sport, benefitting from the trust of international
stakeholders, ITA is a major international organization in delivering anti-doping programmes.
Catalyzed by their partnership agreement, UNESCO and ITA cooperate in support of the objectives set
by the Convention. The COP Bureau and ITA work jointly towards the promotion and protection of
health, education and sport values, integrity and ethics.

Martin Fourcade

Biathlete, Olympic Champion

For us athletes, the ITA is a guarantee of impartiality and expertise in the management of
anti-doping programmes at the global level. We are hopeful that all stakeholders will partner up
with this unique project for the protection of sport. The ITA will contribute to giving trust to all
athletes, allowing them to evolve in a healthy environment.

# Keeping Sport Real

[ITA - About]

#### The International Testing Agency (ITA): For Fairness in Sport

We are dedicated to fairness in all sports. Our vision is to be the world-leading body for
delivering independent and transparent anti-doping programs that help to keep your sport true to its
values of integrity, sportsmanship and fair-play.

As an International Federation, Major Event Organiser, or other sporting body, you will benefit from
our expertise, experience and respect for your priorities. Our aim is to design and carry out
programs that work around you, letting you get on with development from grassroot to elite,
competitions and events in the knowledge that we are giving you the support you need.

## How we can help

[ITA - Athletes]

#### Ready to compete with confidence?

Complying with anti-doping rules is a big responsibility for athletes. You train hard and you train
to win. Your reputation matters and you want your hard work to be recognised. We are here to make
sure that your clean approach to sport is protected, that you can take part in healthy and fair
competitions, and that you and your competitors are treated with the professionalism and respect you
deserve.

As an organisation already sharing our global expertise with athletes around the world, we run a
wide range of education programs that support you to compete fairly, understand the rules and their
enforcement and give you the confidence you need to focus on your training and performances.

[ Read More ][88]

#### Why partner with us?

Bringing global expertise and experience to clean sport: the ITA is committed to delivering a
transparent service that helps organisations and events to be confident in their approach to keeping
sport clean.
Working with us demonstrates your determination to protect your athletes and contribute to
excellence in sporting endeavour. You will have access to our team of anti-doping experts, and you
will be able to demonstrate to your stakeholders, sponsors and fans that you are serious about a
level playing field.

[ Read More ][89]
[ITA - Partners]

## Our Partners

Witold Banka

President, World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA)

We are pleased to see that the expertise of the International Testing Agency is strengthening the
anti-doping programs of International Federations and Major Event Organisers worldwide. By working
to ensure that each have efficient and compliant anti-doping programs, the ITA, along with
Anti-Doping Organizations worldwide, is helping to improve the quality of the global anti-doping
system.

Thomas Bach

Former President, International Olympic Committee (IOC)

The ITA’s initiation by the 2015 Olympic Summit was a major milestone in the fight against doping.
Through the ITA, anti-doping testing becomes independent from sports organisations and national
interests. This independence is vital to ensuring a level playing field for all athletes and greatly
supports the credibility of the anti-doping system.

David Lappartient

President, Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI)

In entrusting its anti-doping operations to the ITA, the UCI ensured that cycling could maintain and
strengthen its mission to protect clean athletes.

Totally independent from the UCI, our sport’s anti-doping programme benefits greatly from the ITA’s
global approach, which guarantees synergies in key areas such as research, science, intelligence and
investigations, testing, and education.

Marcos Diaz

Chairperson of the UNESCO Bureau of the seventh session of the Conference of Parties to the
International Convention against Doping in Sport

As Chairperson of representatives of global public authorities to the Conference of Parties (COP) of
the International Convention against Doping in Sport, benefitting from the trust of international
stakeholders, ITA is a major international organization in delivering anti-doping programmes.
Catalyzed by their partnership agreement, UNESCO and ITA cooperate in support of the objectives set
by the Convention. The COP Bureau and ITA work jointly towards the promotion and protection of
health, education and sport values, integrity and ethics.

Martin Fourcade

Biathlete, Olympic Champion

For us athletes, the ITA is a guarantee of impartiality and expertise in the management of
anti-doping programmes at the global level. We are hopeful that all stakeholders will partner up
with this unique project for the protection of sport. The ITA will contribute to giving trust to all
athletes, allowing them to evolve in a healthy environment.

# Home

### The lead authority in industrial rope access

Industrial rope access has been developed by IRATA International for over 38 years to a point where
it is the chosen means of access for much of the work in the offshore oil and gas industry as well
as a range of projects in construction, civil engineering, the built and natural environment and
much more. Its success is based on thorough training and strict work guidelines that deliver an
unrivalled safe working record year after year. The environmental, efficiency and economic benefits
have resulted in growing international support for industrial rope access ahead of alternative means
of access.

as a range of projects in construction, civil engineering, the built and natural environment and

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][58]
APPLICATION SPOTLIGHT: PIC AND SILICON PHOTONICS TESTING

## See Inside Photonic Integrated Circuits with < 10 μm Resolution

Reliable photonic integrated circuits (PICs) are critical technology for meeting the exponentially
growing demand for more functionality, reliability, integration, scalability, and size and power
reduction. Fast, accurate and complete testing of PICs early and throughout the development cycle is
essential.

[Learn More][59]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][60]
APPLICATION SPOTLIGHT: LATENCY TESTING AND NETWORK DIAGNOSTICS WITH FIBER OPTICS

## Unmatched Accuracy and Precision for Financial Data Center Network Testing

Financial institutions, banks, and trading floors need to keep customer information and transactions
safe, secure and compliant. And it all starts with a reliable, accurate fiber optic network system.

[Learn More][61]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][62]
Application Spotlight: Structural Health Monitoring with Fiber Optic Sensors

## Building Smarter and Safer Infrastructure

Fiber optic sensors enable accurate and dependable structural health monitoring systems that can
span all sizes of structures and capture both static and dynamic phenomenon. Luna's monitoring
system instrumentation includes optical interrogators, long-gage strain sensors, accelerometers,
temperature sensors and tilt meters for crucial structural integrity measurements. 

[Learn More][63]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

[Scroll  ][64]

## Luna Celebrates Innovation and Looks Toward the Future

Recently members of the Luna team traveled to New York City to celebrate new company milestones in
our quest to enable the future with fiber.

[Learn More][65]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

Advanced Fiber Optic Measurement and Monitoring Systems
[Scroll  ][66]
Application Spotlight: Fiber Optic Sensors Improve Material Joining

## Measurements for the Lightweighting Revolution

Widespread automotive lightweighting requires more reliable bonding and joining of composite
materials. In-situ monitoring based on high-definition distributed fiber optic sensors is being used
to provide real-time data to optimize and verify the joining processes.

 

 

[Learn More][67]

#  Enabling the Future with Fiber 

[Scroll  ][68]
Application Spotlight: Tire Calendering

## Better Quality, Improved Safety, and Lower Costs for Tire Manufacturers

For products with fabric cords, the ability to make online balance measurements has not been
available - until now. Luna's terahertz sensor-- using reflections of an emitted energy pulse -- can
provide safe, fast, accurate thickness measurements and simultaneously assess the balance of ply
constructions.

[Learn More][69]

# ambitious brands

* Increase Brand Relevance

  over time, turning resonance into lasting competitive advantage.
* Enter New Markets
  
  Expand your reach. We identify and help you enter new market territories with precision, crafting
  strategies that turn unfamiliar ground into profitable terrain.
* Acquire New Customers
  
  Grow your base. We design experiences and communications that attract the right customers,
  converting awareness into loyalty through meaningful engagement.

  surprise, delight and meaning that competitors simply cannot replicate.
* Increase Customer Lifetime Value

## [FAQ][164]

Q1. Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?
A: We are the manufacturer, specializing in material testing instruments for industries such as
packaging, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food, beverages, and adhesives. Our
headquarters are located in Jinan City, Shandong, China.
Q2. Where can I purchase your material testers?
A: We directly export our testers from China. Additionally, for certain regions, we have local
representatives who handle sales and provide support.
Q3. How is the installation process handled?
A: We generally deliver the testers as whole units, and the operation manual provides detailed
instructions for installation. Moreover, we offer free online installation and commissioning
support.
Q4. Do you provide after-sales service?
A: Yes, as a manufacturer, we can readily identify and guide users to solve any issues. Upon
receiving an after-sale report, we respond within one working day and provide solutions within the
next 8 hours.

## [FAQ][164]

Q1. Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?
A: We are the manufacturer, specializing in material testing instruments for industries such as
packaging, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food, beverages, and adhesives. Our
headquarters are located in Jinan City, Shandong, China.
Q2. Where can I purchase your material testers?
A: We directly export our testers from China. Additionally, for certain regions, we have local
representatives who handle sales and provide support.
Q3. How is the installation process handled?
A: We generally deliver the testers as whole units, and the operation manual provides detailed
instructions for installation. Moreover, we offer free online installation and commissioning
support.
Q4. Do you provide after-sales service?
A: Yes, as a manufacturer, we can readily identify and guide users to solve any issues. Upon
receiving an after-sale report, we respond within one working day and provide solutions within the
next 8 hours.

[ [NextGen Material Testing] ][1]
* * [Products][2]
    * [Special Offers][3]
      * * [Fully Automatic Shore/IRHD Hardness Tester][4]
        * [DIN Abrasion Tester][5]
        * [Pendulum Impact Testers - Charpy and Izod Systems][6]
        * [Micro Vickers and Knoop Hardness Tester][7]
        * [TensileMIll CNC MINI][8]
      * [[Fully Automatic Shore/IRHD Hardness Tester]][9]
        
        An automatic system for Shore, IRHD and VLRH hardness testing of rubber and elastomers.
        
        [[DIN Abrasion Tester]][10]
        
        A DIN abrasion tester that simulates long term wear to measure the abrasion resistance of
        rubber.
        
        [[Pendulum Impact Testers - Charpy and Izod Systems]][11]
        
        Charpy and Izod pendulum impact testers for metals and plastics to ASTM E23 and ISO 148.
        
        [[Micro Vickers and Knoop Hardness Tester]][12]
        
        A digital micro Vickers and Knoop hardness tester with optical analysis to ASTM E384 and ISO
        6507.
        
        [[TensileMIll CNC MINI]][13]
        
        A compact CNC system for preparing flat tensile dog-bone specimens to ASTM E8 and ISO
        6892-1.
        
        [[Special Offers]][14]
        
        Current promotions and special pricing on NextGen material testing and quality control
        equipment.
    * [Metal Testing Equipment][15]
      * * [Universal Testing Machines for Metal Testing][16]
        * [Pendulum Impact Testers - Charpy and Izod Systems][17]
        * [Tensile Sample Preparation Equipment][18]
        * [Metal Hardness Testing Equipment - Bench Top and Portable Solutions][19]
        * [Metallography Sample Preparation Equipment][20]
        * [Consumables – Hardness Testing, Metallography, Tensile and More…][21]
      * [[Universal Testing Machines for Metal Testing]][22]
        
        Universal testing machines for tensile, compression, flexure and bend testing of metals to
        ASTM E8.
        
        [[Pendulum Impact Testers - Charpy and Izod Systems]][23]
        
        Charpy and Izod pendulum impact testers for metals and plastics to ASTM E23 and ISO 148.
        
        [[Tensile Sample Preparation Equipment]][24]
        
        Equipment for preparing flat dog bone and round tensile specimens to ASTM E8.
        
        [[Metal Hardness Testing Equipment - Bench Top and Portable Solutions]][25]
        
        Rockwell, Vickers, Knoop, Brinell and portable hardness testers for metals to ASTM and ISO.
        
        [[Metallography Sample Preparation Equipment]][26]
        
        Cutting, mounting, grinding and polishing equipment for metallographic sample preparation.
        
        [[Consumables – Hardness Testing, Metallography, Tensile and More…]][27]
        
        Consumables and spares for hardness, metallography, tensile preparation and abrasion
        testing.
        
        [[Metal Testing Equipment]][28]
        
        Equipment for testing metals, including hardness testers, universal testing machines, impact
        testers and metallography.
    * [Plastic Testing Equipment][29]
      * * [Electromechanical Universal Testing Machines for Plastic Testing][30]
        * [Fruit Firmness Tester][31]
        * [Automatic Capsule and Soft Gel Hardness Tester][32]
        * [Ball Rebound Tester][33]
        * [Pendulum Rebound Resilience Tester][34]
        * [Pusey & Jones Tester][35]
        * [Advanced Portable Shore Durometer System with Test Stand Options][36]
        * [Automatic Shore, IRHD and VLRH Hardness Testing System][37]
        * [Classic Analogue Shore Durometer with Test Stand Options][38]
